recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-angle portrait of a blonde woman sitting on a white bed in a minimalist, warm-toned room. She is wearing a black backless slip dress and looking over her shoulder toward the camera. A vintage silver laptop with a red heart sticker sits to her left, and a teal curtain provides a vertical color break on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally against a vast, flat beige wall
Contrast between the cool teal curtain and the warm yellow-beige room tones
Interaction between the modern-retro laptop and the soft domestic setting
Triangular composition formed by the subject's posture and the laptop placement
coreInvariants: Warm, slightly yellow-tinted lighting suggestive of late afternoon sun
Minimalist furniture with a focus on negative wall space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is mid-ground, centered horizontally, occupying the lower third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's gaze and the dark silhouette of the black dress against the white bed.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the line of her back down to the bed, moves left to the laptop, and then up the vertical teal curtain.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper two-thirds of the frame, dominated by a flat, unadorned beige wall.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (Heart sticker on laptop and fingernails)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with high value in the background; deep blacks in the dress and boots for grounding.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma primary colors

graphicDevices: Red heart icon as a singular graphic focal point

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photo of a blonde woman in a black backless silk dress sitting on a white bed. The room has flat beige walls, a vintage silver laptop with a small red heart sticker, and a teal curtain on the far right. Use 35mm film aesthetic with warm, soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, spaced-out serif font in the upper negative space, centered, in a dark brown or black color.

verificationChecks: Is the wall color a warm, flat beige?
Is the teal curtain visible on the right edge?
Is the subject looking over her shoulder?
Is the lighting soft and cinematic?

adjustableVariables: Wall color (from beige to soft peach)
Curtain color (from teal to deep forest green)
Laptop model (from 90s bulky to early 2000s slim)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the laptop
Identifiable facial features of a specific celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red heart sticker is the only bright red element.
Check that the teal curtain does not overwhelm the warm palette.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the backless detail of the dress is clear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a minimalist interior with a single vertical color break (curtain), a centered subject in the lower third, and a vintage tech prop to create a nostalgic, cinematic portrait.
